versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the list-building skill for creating targeted company lists using Extruct.
- Guides users through a decision tree to select the best approach: lookalike search, semantic search, or deep search.
- Reads ICP, win cases (seed companies) from the company context file to inform searches.
- Integrates with the extruct-api skill to handle all API operations and data uploads.
- Supports context-aware query design, deduplication, and fit-based filtering for high-quality outbound lists.
- Provides clear workflow steps and guidance for use at different campaign stages.
